chunks: He said, and I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying:

The love of the righteous for the righteous is a reward for the righteous; the love of the immoral for the righteous is a virtue for the righteous; the hatred of the immoral for the righteous is an adornment for the righteous; and the hatred of the righteous for the immoral is a disgrace upon the immoral.

key_terms.الأبرار: The righteous, the pious, the virtuous — those who fulfill their obligations to God and creation
key_terms.الفجار: The immoral, the wicked, the transgressors — those who persist in sin and corruption
key_terms.ثواب: Divine reward; here used for a worldly social phenomenon that mirrors heavenly recompense
key_terms.خزي: Disgrace, humiliation, shame — the hatred of the righteous for the wicked exposes the latter's baseness
key_terms.زين: Adornment, beauty, honor — the hatred of the wicked is a badge of honor for the righteous
key_terms.فضيلة: Virtue, merit, excellence — the love of the wicked for the righteous reflects the latter's moral excellence

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about the love and hatred between the righteous and the wicked?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) articulates a striking ethical calculus: a person's moral standing can be gauged by who loves and who hates them. When the righteous love you, it is your reward; when the wicked hate you, it is your adornment and honor. This teaching was directed at a community needing to distinguish genuine virtue from social approval, encouraging believers not to seek the affection of the corrupt.

en.hubeali: He (the above narrator) said, ‘And I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘

The love of the righteous for the righteous is a Reward for the righteous, and the love of the immoral for the righteous, is a merit for the righteous one, and hatred of the immoral for the righteous one is an adornment for the righteous one, and hatred of the righteous for the immoral is a disgrace upon the immoral one’.
en.sarwar: 6. He has also said, ‘I heard abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) saying: “

The virtuous ones’ love of other virtuous ones is a rewarding deed for them. Indecent ones loving the virtuous ones is a credit for the virtuous ones. Indecent ones’ hating the virtuous ones beautifies the virtuous ones. Virtuous one’s hating the indecent ones is a loss to the indecent ones.”
